about: What a changed path does to the pre-push scope. prepush-scope.ts and test-impact.ts read this file and nothing else decides a full run. full: the path is an input of every module's build, so every module's check runs and the test selection does not narrow. docs: prose no law reads, so no module is checked. laws: a law suite reads the path, so pre-push requests lawSuites and gradle's up-to-date check runs the suite whose inputs changed. A path in none of these selects the module that owns it, plus the modules that depend on it. A ladder row runs when a changed path matches one of its inputs. A pattern that is only ** matches every path and selects nothing.
